# Funeral Assistance: what to gather

We are very sorry for your loss. FEMA may help with funeral costs when a death was caused directly or indirectly by a declared disaster.

We could not confirm Individual Assistance for Harris County yet. Check DisasterAssistance.gov or call 1-800-621-3362; declarations are often expanded later.

- [ ] Death certificate, OR the signed certifier statement Counted drafted (ask the medical examiner or doctor to review and sign it)
- [ ] Funeral home contract or itemized receipts
- [ ] Proof of any other help received (insurance, burial societies, donations)
- [ ] The decedent's and applicant's names and addresses

Apply at DisasterAssistance.gov or call 1-800-621-3362. If FEMA says no, you can appeal in writing using the appeal letter below.

_Counted cannot promise any outcome. FEMA makes the decision._
